title: Order refunded
description: A Tenant's system recorded a return against an order in crm; the event carries the order's complete current state after the return plus the return that caused it. `orderVersion` is monotonic per order and rose with this return, so a receiver that keeps the order's state drops a delivery whose `orderVersion` is not newer. `return` lets a forwarder call loyalty's return endpoint without reading crm. The event's `aggregate` is `order/<orderRef>`. This schema describes the `data` member; the envelope is described in ../../messaging/README.md.

customerId.description: crm's own opaque id for the customer the order belongs to.

externalRef.description: The Tenant's reference for the customer, so a receiver can match the order without reading crm.

orderRef.description: The Tenant's reference for the order, unique per Tenant. The idempotency key of the order.

orderVersion.description: The order's version, monotonic per order and rising with every return. A receiver that keeps the order's state drops a delivery whose `orderVersion` is not newer than the one it holds.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 code every amount in this payload is denominated in.

total.description: The order total in minor units of `currency`.

occurredAt.description: When the order was placed, in UTC.

storeCode.description: The Tenant's code for the store the order was placed in.

channel.description: The Tenant's name for the channel the order came through, for example `pos` or `web`.

lines.description: Every line of the order, each with its cumulative returned quantity and amount, after this return.

lineNo.description: The line's number within the order, starting at 1.

category.description: The Tenant's category for the line.

quantity.description: The quantity sold, with up to three fraction digits.

amount.description: The line's net amount in minor units of the order currency, net of discount.

earnEligible.description: Whether the line earns points; false for lines a promotion or the Tenant excludes.

returnedQuantity.description: The cumulative quantity returned across every return of this order, with up to three fraction digits. Never exceeds `quantity`.

returnedAmount.description: The cumulative amount returned across every return of this order, in minor units of the order currency. Never exceeds `amount`.

return.description: The return that caused this event, so a forwarder can call loyalty's return endpoint without reading crm.

returnRef.description: The Tenant's reference for the return, unique per Tenant. The idempotency key of the return.

occurredAt.description: When the return was made, in UTC.

lines.description: The returned lines of this return, not the cumulative state.

lineNo.description: The number of the order line this return names.

quantity.description: The quantity returned in this return, with up to three fraction digits.

amount.description: The amount returned in this return, in minor units of the order currency.
